settings.openchamber.defaults.field.sess: Some providers forget a conversation's cached context after a few minutes of silence, so the next message is slower and costs more. With this on, OpenCode sends a tiny "OK" request every 4 minutes while a session sits idle, for up to 30 minutes after your last message. Each ping is billed as a small request. Applies to all projects.
